newsitem.title: USA: Sun Micro EPS view upped by Dean WItter.
newsitem.headline: Sun Micro EPS view upped by Dean WItter.

text.p: Dean Witter analyst Jay Stevens said he slightly raised his fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1998 earnings estimates on Sun Microsystems Inc and maintains a buy rating, after the company's strong first quarter.
Stevens said he raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $3.45 a share from $3.40 previously and raised his fiscal 1998 estimate to $4.15 a share, from $4.10 previously.

"They delivered a very fine quarter," Stevens said, but he added that the stock was likely down in pre-opening trading because many momentum investors had even higher expectations than the $0.63 a share that Sun reported on Tuesday.

"They had a very high gross margin and so they deliberately increased their R&D (research and development)," Stevens said, adding that the company also benefitted from lower memory chip prices in the quarter -- a one-time event for now, as DRAM prices are again on the rise this quarter.
The consensus on Wall Street was for Sun to report first quarter earnings of $0.61 a share, according to First Call.
